description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called SkillsSettings that manages and displays a list of skills, including filtering, updating environment variables, installation options, and status updates. It also includes the SkillsSettingsModel class that handles the asynchronous fetching and updating of skill data, making network calls to GatewayConnection for skill status, updates, and installation.

classes.name: SkillsSettingsModel
classes.description: An observable class managing the state of skills, including fetching status, installation, and updates.

classes.name: EnvEditorState
classes.description: A struct representing the state of environment variables editing UI

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the latest skills status from the server asynchronously.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Performs the installation of a skill with a specified option and target asynchronously.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a skill asynchronously.

methods.name: updateEnv
methods.description: Updates environment variables or API keys for a skill asynchronously.

methods.name: isBusy
methods.description: Checks if a particular skill is currently busy performing an operation.
